pages.title: Blackbuck
pages.text: The blackbuck ($(o)Antilope cervicapra$()) is an antelope native to the grasslands and open woodlands of India and Nepal.$(br2)Males are dark brown to black above and white below, and carry long, ringed horns twisted into a corkscrew spiral. Females are fawn-coloured and usually hornless.$(br2)Blackbuck graze in herds on open plains, and have been introduced to Texas and Argentina.
